label: copy-build
command: npm run build:single && bash .agents/scripts/one-shot-grow.sh replay dusk-fish --as copy

label: preflight
command: bash .agents/scripts/yaml-helper.sh resolve_config --keys automation,automation_always_ask,workflow,review_mode && "$CGS_PYTHON" .agents/scripts/rule-routing.py src tests data design/game-brief.md production/qa/evidence docs/engine-reference project.yaml && "$CGS_PYTHON" production/qa/evidence/core-grow/raw/hash.py after

label: copy-commit
command: git add -- .gitignore package.json package-lock.json vite.config.ts tsconfig.json playwright.config.ts src/hook.ts src/config.js src/config-source.js src/main.js src/dev/tune.ts index.html data/config.json data/config-notes.md assets/provenance.yaml design/feel-log.md production/qa/evidence/grow-dusk-fish/copy.tsv production/qa/evidence/grow-dusk-fish/copy.png && git commit -m "迁移 dusk-fish 为 Web 工程并验证配置初始化等价" -- .gitignore package.json package-lock.json vite.config.ts tsconfig.json playwright.config.ts src/hook.ts src/config.js src/config-source.js src/main.js src/dev/tune.ts index.html data/config.json data/config-notes.md assets/provenance.yaml design/feel-log.md production/qa/evidence/grow-dusk-fish/copy.tsv production/qa/evidence/grow-dusk-fish/copy.png

label: typescript-check
command: npx --no-install tsc --noEmit

label: typescript-replay
command: npm run build:single && bash .agents/scripts/one-shot-grow.sh replay dusk-fish --as typescript

label: typescript-commit
command: git add -- src/main.js src/config.js src/config-source.js src/main.ts src/config.ts src/art.ts src/screen.ts src/input.ts src/game/types.ts src/game/rules.ts index.html production/qa/evidence/grow-dusk-fish/typescript.tsv production/qa/evidence/grow-dusk-fish/typescript.png && git commit -m "拆分 dusk-fish 为严格类型模块并保持同种子回放一致" -- src/main.js src/config.js src/config-source.js src/main.ts src/config.ts src/art.ts src/screen.ts src/input.ts src/game/types.ts src/game/rules.ts index.html production/qa/evidence/grow-dusk-fish/typescript.tsv production/qa/evidence/grow-dusk-fish/typescript.png

label: rule-red
command: npm run test:unit

label: tests-green
command: npm test

label: tests-green-corrected
command: npm test

label: tests-commit
command: git diff --exit-code -- src/game/rules.ts && git add -- tests/unit/rules.test.ts tests/integration/boot.spec.ts production/qa/evidence/core-grow/round2/rule-red.log production/qa/evidence/core-grow/round2/tests-green.log production/qa/evidence/core-grow/round2/tests-green-corrected.log && git commit -m "验证钓鱼规则红绿测试及浏览器启动与确定性回放" -- tests/unit/rules.test.ts tests/integration/boot.spec.ts production/qa/evidence/core-grow/round2/rule-red.log production/qa/evidence/core-grow/round2/tests-green.log production/qa/evidence/core-grow/round2/tests-green-corrected.log

label: record
command: bash .agents/scripts/one-shot-grow.sh record dusk-fish && npm run build && bash .agents/scripts/test-run.sh web --log production/qa/evidence/core-grow/round2/test-run-grow.log && npm run smoke

label: grow-commit
command: git add -- project.yaml docs/engine-reference/web/VERSION.md design/game-brief.md production/qa/evidence/grow-dusk-fish/grow.md production/qa/evidence/core-grow/round2/record.log production/qa/evidence/core-grow/round2/test-run-grow.log production/qa/evidence/core-grow/round2/test-run-grow.log.unit production/qa/evidence/core-grow/round2/test-run-grow.log.e2e && git commit -m "完成 dusk-fish Web 迁移记录与构建测试交接" -- project.yaml docs/engine-reference/web/VERSION.md design/game-brief.md production/qa/evidence/grow-dusk-fish/grow.md production/qa/evidence/core-grow/round2/record.log production/qa/evidence/core-grow/round2/test-run-grow.log production/qa/evidence/core-grow/round2/test-run-grow.log.unit production/qa/evidence/core-grow/round2/test-run-grow.log.e2e && git tag grown/dusk-fish

label: retry-red
command: npx --no-install playwright test tests/integration/retry.spec.ts

label: retry-green
command: npm run test:e2e

label: story
command: npm run smoke && npm run build:single && bash .agents/scripts/one-shot-grow.sh replay dusk-fish --as story

label: story-compare
command: "$CGS_PYTHON" production/qa/evidence/core-grow/round2/compare-replay.py && node production/qa/evidence/core-grow/round2/compare-shots.mjs

label: final-checks
command: npm run build && npm test && bash .agents/scripts/test-run.sh web --log production/qa/evidence/core-grow/round2/test-run-final.log && npm run smoke

label: feature-commit
command: bash .agents/scripts/one-shot-grow.sh accept dusk-fish && git diff -- src/main.ts design/game-brief.md && git add -- src/main.ts tests/integration/retry.spec.ts design/game-brief.md production/qa/evidence/grow-dusk-fish/story.tsv production/qa/evidence/grow-dusk-fish/story.png production/qa/evidence/grow-dusk-fish/accepted.tsv production/qa/evidence/grow-dusk-fish/accepted.png production/qa/evidence/core-grow/round2/retry-red.log production/qa/evidence/core-grow/round2/retry-green.log production/qa/evidence/core-grow/round2/story-state-comparison.json production/qa/evidence/core-grow/round2/story-pixel-comparison.json production/qa/evidence/core-grow/round2/retry-over.json production/qa/evidence/core-grow/round2/retry-results.json production/qa/evidence/core-grow/round2/retry-over-before.png production/qa/evidence/core-grow/round2/retry-over-after.png production/qa/evidence/core-grow/round2/retry-results-before.png production/qa/evidence/core-grow/round2/retry-results-after.png && git commit -m "新增结果画面按 R 重试并保留 Enter 与局内行为" -- src/main.ts tests/integration/retry.spec.ts design/game-brief.md production/qa/evidence/grow-dusk-fish/story.tsv production/qa/evidence/grow-dusk-fish/story.png production/qa/evidence/grow-dusk-fish/accepted.tsv production/qa/evidence/grow-dusk-fish/accepted.png production/qa/evidence/core-grow/round2/retry-red.log production/qa/evidence/core-grow/round2/retry-green.log production/qa/evidence/core-grow/round2/story-state-comparison.json production/qa/evidence/core-grow/round2/story-pixel-comparison.json production/qa/evidence/core-grow/round2/retry-over.json production/qa/evidence/core-grow/round2/retry-results.json production/qa/evidence/core-grow/round2/retry-over-before.png production/qa/evidence/core-grow/round2/retry-over-after.png production/qa/evidence/core-grow/round2/retry-results-before.png production/qa/evidence/core-grow/round2/retry-results-after.png

label: audit-final
command: "$CGS_PYTHON" production/qa/evidence/core-grow/raw/hash.py after && "$CGS_PYTHON" production/qa/evidence/core-grow/round2/audit.py after && git diff --exit-code HEAD && git diff --cached --name-only && git log -5 --format="%h %s" && git ls-files .agents .codex AGENTS.md && npm ls --depth=0

label: git-final
command: git diff --exit-code HEAD && git diff --cached --name-only && git log -5 --format="%h %s" && git ls-files .agents .codex AGENTS.md && npm ls --depth=0 && git diff --name-only 5b90e81..HEAD

label: scope-summary
command: "$CGS_PYTHON" production/qa/evidence/core-grow/round2/summary-audit.py
